The decisive mistake was at the very start. The actual task was to find which astronaut in the smaller astronaut's NASA group spent the least time in space. Instead, PythonDebugging_Expert treated the question as a code-debugging problem around the output "Nowak 2160". Its scripts hardcode "Nowak" and 2160 rather than researching the answer, and every later step built on that framing. The final answer should have been "White; 5876".
